needs_human.note: Smart Collection queue loop default is ON (CollectionPanel.tsx getSmartLoop), not OFF as for collections; see READ-1.; CollectionPanel.tsx adds aria-labels 'Move up', 'Move down', 'Remove from collection' (en/ja messages) to the existing collection-mode buttons. These are new screen-reader strings for the collection surface that the spec does not mention. The buttons are only rendered for user collections, so they are not drawn in the Smart Collection queue.
